stemMarkdown: In a race of 400 m, the ratio of speeds of A and B is 11:8. If they start together, by what distance (in m) does A win when A finishes the race? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 400 m, B covers $\dfrac{8}{11} \times 400 = 290.91$ m (same time, speeds proportional to distance covered). A wins by $= 400 - 290.91 = 109.09$ m.
